Definition: from G3739 and G4218; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as:--when.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hopóte means when. It occurs just once, in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hopóte as it stands — when — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
RelatedEvents: The Disciples Pluck Grain on the Sabbath
